l3UsageSemantics.meaning: Declared dust-container volume is comparable capacity evidence, not a cleaning interval guarantee.
Maximum electrical input power describes consumption/input only and cannot rank suction or cleaning performance.
Declared operating radius supports a bounded reach check, not room coverage or cable-length equivalence.
Published mass supports same-context handling discussion, not perceived effort on stairs.
Declared noise supports same-regime display, not perceived quietness in a particular home.
Filtration is comparable only under the same verified label and test standard; HEPA wording alone does not prove equivalent capture or health outcome.
Verified supplied-head states answer exact equipment requirements only and do not guarantee surface or pet-hair results.
Washable-filter presence is a maintenance feature, not a filter-life or hygiene guarantee.
